notes: Reached GB storefront via the Akamai interstitial proof-of-work solver (curl_cffi chrome-impersonation session). Checked: the full mega-menu tree embedded as JSON in the homepage's serverApp-state, robots.txt, and the site's own GB category sitemap (sitemap-home-categories-zh-gb-0.xml.gz, 322 URLs). The only discount/markdown-style page anywhere on the GB storefront is 'Special Prices', a top-level nav item with its own standalone canonical URL https://www.zarahome.com/gb/special-prices-n1170 (confirmed present in the sitemap as its own page, seoId 1170, not a celement-anchored widget like the site's non-genuine Bestsellers entries). Opened it directly and inspected the actual page: <title> = 'Zara Home Special Prices | Zara Home United Kingdom'; its own <meta name=description> reads verbatim 'Discover the Zara Home Sale. Offers on decor and textiles for the home aligned with the brand's well-known style.' -- i.e. the site's own copy self-describes this as a Sale/Offers campaign. Full-text scanned the rendered page for clearance/outlet/final-sale/last-chance/end-of-line/permanent/discontinued language: zero genuine hits (the only 'outlet' substring matches found were Angular's <router-outlet> component tag, not page content). No breadcrumb, heading ('Zara Home Special Prices' h1), or on-page copy anywhere frames it as permanent-markdown/outlet/end-of-line stock. Per the brief's Clearance-vs-Sale test (a page called Sale/Offers/Discounts with no permanence signal is excluded, not force-included), this is a generic promotional Sale page, not Clearance -- excluded with confidence, not flagged as ambiguous, since the page's own self-description ('Sale', 'Offers') and total absence of any clearance/outlet wording leave no real doubt. Also checked withdrawn-from-sale-n5187 ('WITHDRAWAL OF ITEMS' nav link) -- this is a product-recall/discontinuation notice page, not a merchandising clearance listing, and excluded on that basis. No separate Outlet/Clearance/Final-Sale/Last-Chance/End-of-Line URL exists anywhere in nav, sitemap, or robots.txt (full-text scan of all 322 sitemap URLs for 'outlet'/'clearance'/'sale' returned only special-prices-n1170). Concluding no genuine Clearance PLP exists on Zara Home GB.
